The ONBRILL 61" x 31" Kitchen Island Table combines style and functionality with these standout features:

• 
Premium 1.8" Thick Tabletop – Solid engineered wood with a realistic marble finish for a high-end look


• 
Built-in Power & USB – 2 AC outlets + 2 USB ports with a 2-meter cord to charge devices directly at the table


• 
Adjustable RGB LED Lighting – Multiple color modes with music sync for customizable ambiance


• 
3-Tier Storage Shelf – Spacious side shelving to organize cutlery, condiments, and small appliances


• 
Seating for 4 – Counter-height design (35.4") perfect for dining, working, or entertaining


• 
Heavy-Duty & Sturdy – Customers consistently praise its quality and durability

Reviewers highlight its excellent quality, beautiful appearance, and great value for the price. Just note: it's very heavy (136 lbs), so you'll need two people to move it safely.

The ONBRILL 61" Kitchen Island Table is designed for multiple user types and scenarios:
Ideal Target Users:

• 
Small apartment dwellers — Customers mention it "elevates a small space" and works as a space-efficient dining + work solution


• 
Work-from-home professionals — The built-in power outlets (2 AC + 2 USB) let you charge laptops, monitors, and devices directly at the table


• 
Content creators & streamers — The RGB LED with music sync creates professional ambiance for videos, podcasts, or live streams ("we use it in our studio for filming")


• 
Entertaining hosts — Counter-height design seats 4 comfortably for dinner parties or casual gatherings


• 
Coffee shop / small business owners — Suitable as a serving counter or collaborative workspace


• 
Home organizers — The 3-tier adjustable storage shelf keeps cutlery, condiments, and small appliances within reach

Best Use Cases:

• 
Kitchen + Dining hybrid — Works as both a food prep zone and dining area simultaneously


• 
Workspace + Break area — Perfect for home offices that double as eating spaces


• 
Studio / creative space — RGB lighting makes it ideal for filming or photography backgrounds


• 
Extra workspace in small kitchens — Adds functional counter space without requiring major renovations

Key advantage: Unlike traditional dining tables, this island combines dining + storage + power + lighting, making it highly practical for multi-functional living spaces where square footage is limited.
Would you like sizing guidance for your specific space, or details on whether it suits your kitchen layout?

Based on customer reviews, here's what buyers love most about the ONBRILL Kitchen Island Table:
Quality & Durability (21 positive mentions)
Customers consistently praise the excellent build quality. Reviews highlight "seriously good quality," "high-end" finish, and many say it exceeded expectations. One buyer noted: "Came in perfectly, no scuffs or defects or missing pieces. It's very sturdy and surprised at how heavy weight and good quality it is."
Stunning Appearance (18 of 19 mentions positive)
The marble texture is a major draw. Reviewers say "everyone keeps saying how beautiful it is" and appreciate the "elegant look" and "sleek, high-end finish." One content creator mentioned using it in their studio for filming because of the professional appearance.
Sturdiness & Stability (100% positive)
Customers feel confident the table won't wobble or collapse. Phrases like "super sturdy," "stable," and "doesn't scratch easily" appear repeatedly—important for a furniture investment.
Great Value for Money (7 of 8 mentions positive)
Many customers feel they got their money's worth, with reviews like "definitely worth the price" and "wonderful price for something so lovely."
Perfect for Small Spaces (kitchen utility category)
Buyers love how it "elevates a small space," provides "extra workspace," and adds style without taking up too much room in apartments.
Note: The main complaint is about LED reliability—several buyers mention the lights arrived damaged or stopped working. This is the one feature that's holding back an even higher rating.

Based on customer reviews, here are the main complaints about the ONBRILL Kitchen Island Table:
LED Light Reliability (Critical Issue)
This is the #1 complaint. Multiple buyers report the LED lights arrived damaged or non-functional, with one reviewer saying "the only thing is...I really wish the LED worked being that it was the final step to make it all come together." Several others mention lights that "don't work" or stopped working shortly after arrival. This significantly impacts satisfaction since the RGB lighting is a major selling feature.
Shipping Damage (Cosmetic Issues)
Several customers received their tables with damaged corners and chipped edges. One buyer noted: "Table is beautiful! But I received it damaged 😪 every corner chipped and damaged!!" This appears to be a packaging/shipping issue rather than a manufacturing defect.
Very Heavy & Difficult to Move (Practical Concern)
Reviews consistently mention the table is "extremely heavy" (136 lbs) and requires at least 2 people to assemble and move. One buyer said it "wasn't too difficult to build (hired professional builders)" — suggesting the weight is genuinely challenging.
Knee Room Limitation (Design Constraint)
One customer noted: "the shelving on one side takes up too much knee room," particularly problematic if two larger adults sit next to each other on the same side.
Sharp Corners (Safety Issue)
One parent mentioned "sharp corners though for kids" — a concern if you have young children in the home.
Overall Context: Most complaints are about the LED (a product quality issue) and shipping damage (fulfillment issue), not the table's core structure or dining functionality. The quality and sturdiness of the actual table get consistent praise.

Key Takeaways:

• 
ONBRILL's biggest advantage is its combination of the highest verified rating (4.4★ with 75 reviews), whole-board 1.8" tabletop with no splicing, and music-sync RGB LED — features most competitors list but fewer deliver reliably


• 
ComfyCorner (B0HCXWZWNF) is nearly identical in specs and dimensions at a potentially lower price point, but has no reviews yet — making it hard to verify real-world quality


• 
Homiflex (55") is mobile/on wheels and lighter (98 lbs) — better if you need to move the island around, but smaller and has a lower rating (3.7★)


• 
HUATOL (71") offers more seating (4–6 people) and an extra USB-C port, but is a newer listing with very few reviews (3 reviews, 3.5★)


• 
ONBRILL's main weakness vs. competitors: LED reliability complaints, as noted in reviews — a concern shared across this entire category

Bottom line: ONBRILL leads on verified customer satisfaction and build quality among this product type, but the LED reliability issue is a category-wide problem to watch for.

Based on everything we know about the ONBRILL 61" Kitchen Island Table, here's an honest value assessment:
What you're getting for the price:

• 
350 lb weight capacity — heavy-duty construction for a furniture piece in this category


• 
1.8" whole-board tabletop (no splicing) — a premium build detail competitors often cut corners on


• 
Built-in 2 AC outlets + 2 USB ports — adds real utility that standalone tables don't offer


• 
RGB LED with music sync — a premium feature, when it works


• 
3-tier adjustable storage shelf — replaces the need for a separate organizer


• 
Seats 4 at counter height (35.4") — functional as both a kitchen island and dining table

What customers say about value:

• 
88% of value-related reviews are positive — phrases like "definitely worth the price," "wonderful price for something so lovely," and "great value" appear consistently


• 
Buyers note it "elevates a small space" and provides both style and function


• 
One reviewer summarized it well: "You get what you pay for"

Value caveats to consider:

• 
LED reliability issues are the main risk — if the lights don't work, you're losing one of the headline features


• 
136 lbs weight may mean paying for professional assembly (one buyer did)


• 
No price history data is available yet, as this is a relatively new listing (first available August 2025), so it's hard to assess whether the current price represents a deal or a baseline


• 
Competitor pricing data is also not available right now for external comparison

Overall: Customer sentiment strongly supports this as a good value purchase — the build quality, multi-functionality, and aesthetics consistently exceed expectations at this price point. The main risk is the LED feature, which is hit-or-miss based on reviews.
